strengths: Each lesson has a single, clear learning goal that is age-appropriate and specific
Most lessons have exactly 2 decision points, keeping complexity manageable for teachers
Excellent material lists and visual support specifications make lessons substitute-friendly
Troubleshooting sections provide concrete solutions for common challenges
Activities are clearly structured with opening/main/closing format
weaknesses: Some lessons could benefit from even simpler language in the troubleshooting sections
A few activities might require more preparation time than typical substitutes have available

strengths: Logical sequence from 2D shapes (lessons 1-10) to 3D solids (lessons 11-14) to integration (lessons 15-20)
Vocabulary builds systematically: basic shapes → properties → spatial concepts → applications
Skills progress from recognition to manipulation to creation to real-world application
Sensory learning approaches (touch, movement, art) spiral throughout the unit
Assessment complexity increases appropriately from identification to explanation to demonstration
weaknesses: Some concepts like 'empreintes' (lesson 14) might be introduced too late in the sequence
The jump from basic properties to career applications (lesson 16) could use more scaffolding
Vocabulary load in later lessons becomes quite heavy

strengths: Decision points reflect genuine classroom dilemmas teachers face daily
Real-world connections are meaningful and age-appropriate (classroom objects, nature, cooking)
Multiple learning modalities accommodate different student needs authentically
Troubleshooting scenarios address actual student misconceptions about geometry
Assessment strategies are practical and observational rather than formal testing
Cultural inclusivity in career examples and material choices
weaknesses: Some activities (like the cooking lesson) may face practical constraints in many schools
Festival celebration lesson might be challenging to implement with limited resources
Time allocations might be optimistic for some complex activities
